slots.label: Aries–Libra axis
slots.kernel: Aries and Libra are the cardinal axis of self and other — both poles initiate, one by acting, the other by relating. Aries asserts a life by starting things; Libra makes life liveable by weighing and relating. Each completes the other: Libra gives Aries' drive someone to act with rather than against, and Aries gives Libra's fairness the nerve to choose. Without the pairing, will has no counterpart and harmony has nobody home.

texts.jungian: The first axis of the zodiac sets the ego's oldest question: how to be someone without being alone. Aries carries the raw 'I am'; Libra carries the discovered 'you exist' — and whichever pole is lived, the other tends to arrive from outside, worn by partners and opponents until it is recognised as one's own.
texts.mundane: In daily life this axis runs between initiative and negotiation: starting things, versus keeping the peace among the people they affect. Strong Aries placements push ahead and apologise later; strong Libra placements consult first and can wait too long — most careers and marriages need a working exchange rate between the two.
texts.energy: A fast, sparking current meets a poising one: thrust and counterweight on the same wire. When the pair works, action stays graceful and diplomacy keeps its nerve; when it splits, the system alternates between collision and stalemate.
texts.minimal: Self versus other, the first axis. Aries starts; Libra weighs. Overdone: combat, or appeasement.

slots.ask: Under pressure, do you act first or consult first — and what has that cost?

revision.prevKernel: Aries and Libra are one axis: the self that acts and the other who answers. Aries asserts a life by starting things; Libra makes life liveable by weighing and relating. Without each other, will has no counterpart and harmony has nobody home.

slots.label: Taurus–Scorpio axis
slots.kernel: Taurus and Scorpio are the fixed axis of substance — both poles endure and resist, so this is a pairing that changes only from within. Taurus holds what is mine and can be kept; Scorpio penetrates what is shared, merged and finally transformed. Each is the other's completion: Taurus gives Scorpio's intensity a ground that survives being remade, and Scorpio saves Taurus's holding from hardening into a hoard. Security without depth goes inert; intensity without ground consumes itself.

texts.jungian: This is the axis of possession and surrender: the ego's need to have and hold, set against the psyche's need to merge and be remade. What Taurus builds, Scorpio composts — and the personality matures by discovering that letting go is not the loss of substance but its transformation.
texts.mundane: Money, bodies and belongings live here: earning and keeping on one side; inheritance, debt, sex and shared resources on the other. Comfortable routines meet the crises that redistribute everything — the practical art is owning things without being owned by them.
texts.energy: A slow, accumulating charge meets a concentrated, discharging one — the battery and the lightning. Held together they give staying power that can also regenerate; split apart, one pole hoards while the other burns the stores down.
texts.minimal: Keeping versus transforming. Taurus holds; Scorpio burns through. Both are about what matters.

slots.ask: What are you keeping safe that might be asking to change?

revision.prevKernel: Taurus and Scorpio are one axis about substance: what is mine and can be kept, against what is shared, merged and inevitably changed. Taurus holds and stabilises; Scorpio penetrates and transforms. Security without depth goes inert; intensity without ground consumes itself.

slots.label: Gemini–Sagittarius axis
slots.kernel: Gemini and Sagittarius are the mutable axis of mind — both poles adapt and keep moving, one between facts, the other between horizons. Gemini gathers particulars — names, facts, conversations; Sagittarius wants the pattern that makes them mean something. Each completes the other: Gemini's detail keeps Sagittarius' meaning honest, and Sagittarius' direction keeps Gemini's chatter going somewhere. Facts without meaning scatter; meaning without facts inflates.

texts.jungian: The near mind and the far mind are one function split in two: curiosity that collects, and conviction that connects. Each pole shadows the other — the collector secretly longs for a creed, and the believer quietly fears the detail that doesn't fit.
texts.mundane: Errands, messages and local knowledge sit at one end; travel, study, publishing and belief at the other. The axis shows in how someone learns and teaches — quick versatile exchange, or the long argument toward a worldview — and good teachers work both ends of it.
texts.energy: A darting, branching current meets a long-arcing one: signal traffic against trajectory. Together they make thought that travels, detail feeding direction; apart, the system chatters without going anywhere, or launches without checking the map.
texts.minimal: Near mind, far mind. Gemini collects the facts; Sagittarius wants their meaning. Each corrects the other.

slots.ask: Which do you trust first — the telling detail, or the big picture?

revision.prevKernel: Gemini and Sagittarius are one axis of mind: the near view and the far view. Gemini gathers particulars — names, facts, conversations; Sagittarius wants the pattern that makes them mean something. Facts without meaning scatter; meaning without facts inflates.

slots.label: Cancer–Capricorn axis
slots.kernel: Cancer and Capricorn are the cardinal axis of roots and role — both poles initiate, one by nurturing, the other by building. Cancer protects the inner, remembered world; Capricorn structures the outer, accountable one. Each completes the other: Cancer gives Capricorn's ambition something worth protecting, and Capricorn gives Cancer's care a structure that holds. The parental inheritance rides on both ends.

texts.jungian: This is the parental axis: the remembered mother-world of belonging and the father-world of demand, however the actual parents distributed the parts. The adult task is to stop commuting between them — to build a life in which being held and being responsible are no longer opposites.
texts.mundane: Home and career sit at either end, and time given to one is felt at the other — the oldest work-life ledger there is. Strength at the Cancer end makes places that hold people; strength at the Capricorn end builds things that outlast them; either way, the family past tends to set the terms of ambition.
texts.energy: A tidal, containing current meets a slow crystallising one: the spring and the masonry. In cooperation, feeling supplies the reason for structure and structure gives feeling somewhere safe to live; in conflict, the home drains the career or the career hollows the home.
texts.minimal: Roots versus role: the parental axis. Cancer holds; Capricorn builds. Each funds the other.

slots.ask: When work and home pull at once, which wins by default — and who decided that?

revision.prevKernel: Cancer and Capricorn are one axis between private roots and public role: where you come from and are held, against what you build and answer for. Cancer protects the inner, remembered world; Capricorn structures the outer, accountable one. The parental inheritance rides on both ends.

slots.label: Leo–Aquarius axis
slots.kernel: Leo and Aquarius are the fixed axis of the individual and the collective — both poles hold their ground, one as the heart that must shine, the other as the mind that belongs to something larger. Leo personalises, warm and sometimes autocratic; Aquarius generalises, cooler, progressive, quick to rebel. Each completes the other: Aquarius' wide view saves Leo's dominance from mere display, and Leo's living warmth saves Aquarius' principles from going cold and abstract. Both create — Leo through art made personal, Aquarius through intuition of the pattern. Warmth without perspective turns theatrical; perspective without warmth turns cold.

texts.jungian: The king and the citizen share one throne: the need to be singular, and the need to be one among equals. Whichever pole the ego claims, the other returns as critique — the performer haunted by the group's judgement, the reformer secretly hungry to be special.
texts.mundane: Creative work, romance and children sit at one end; friends, causes and networks at the other. Leo-weighted people lead from the front and take things personally; Aquarius-weighted people organise, theorise and keep a cooler distance — a team needs both its star and its system.
texts.energy: A radiant central current meets a distributing one — the sun and the grid. Aligned, personal fire lights common purposes; opposed, charisma competes with the collective, or the collective flattens the spark.
texts.minimal: The heart versus the group. Leo shines as itself; Aquarius joins the pattern. Both are loyal, differently.

slots.ask: Where do you most want recognition — as unrepeatable, or as truly one of us?

revision.prevKernel: Leo and Aquarius are one axis between the individual and the collective: the heart that must shine as itself, and the mind that belongs to something larger than any self. Leo personalises; Aquarius generalises. Warmth without perspective turns theatrical; perspective without warmth turns cold.

slots.label: Virgo–Pisces axis
slots.kernel: Virgo and Pisces are the mutable axis of order and ocean — both poles yield and adapt, one by refining, the other by dissolving. Virgo separates and refines the daily craft; Pisces merges and forgives what refinement can't fix. Each completes the other: Virgo gives Pisces' compassion a usable form, and Pisces gives Virgo's precision something to serve beyond itself. This is the axis of service and sacrifice.

texts.jungian: Discrimination and dissolution are one movement of the soul: sorting the world into what serves, then surrendering the sorter. Virgo's precision guards against Pisces' undertow, and Pisces' mercy redeems Virgo's verdicts — competence and grace quarrel here until they marry.
texts.mundane: Routines, health and useful work sit at one end; retreat, imagination and the unbudgeted hours at the other. Virgo-strong lives run on lists and improvements, Pisces-strong ones on tides and exceptions — the workable version keeps a clean desk with the door left open.
texts.energy: A fine filtering current meets a boundless one: the sieve and the sea. In rhythm, inspiration arrives and gets built into usable form; out of rhythm, the system tightens into worry or leaks into fog.
texts.minimal: Order versus ocean. Virgo refines; Pisces dissolves. Service is the shared verb.

slots.ask: What do you tidy when you're anxious — and what do you let blur?

revision.prevKernel: Virgo and Pisces are one axis between order and ocean: the discriminating craft that makes daily life work, and the dissolving compassion that makes it bearable. Virgo separates and refines; Pisces merges and forgives. This is the axis of service and sacrifice.

slots.label: Aries (pole of the Aries–Libra axis)
slots.kernel: Aries is the igniting pole of the Aries–Libra axis: direct, pioneering, quick to start and quick to burn clean. What it lacks by design — weighing, pairing, the other's view — lives across the wheel in Libra.

texts.jungian: Aries carries the archetype of the beginner: identity proven by daring, anger near the surface and quickly spent. Its shadow is the unconsidered other — Libra — who returns as the partner demanding consultation just when momentum feels sweetest.
texts.mundane: First to volunteer, first to act, best in the opening move and bored by maintenance. Life tends to hire a Libra — the partner or colleague whose role is to say 'wait, let's ask them first'.
texts.energy: Cardinal fire: an ignition current — sharp rise, short arc. It moves first and thinks in motion; balance is not native here but borrowed from the opposite pole, and the borrowing steadies the burn.
texts.minimal: Direct, pioneering, fast to ignite. Libra across the axis supplies the weighing.

slots.ask: What happens to your fire when someone says 'let's think about it'?

slots.label: Taurus (pole of the Taurus–Scorpio axis)
slots.kernel: Taurus is the holding pole of the Taurus–Scorpio axis: steady, embodied, loyal to the tangible and the proven. Its complement is Scorpio — the depth and intensity it prefers not to disturb.

texts.jungian: Taurus incarnates the conserving instinct: peace through possession, calm through the body, change admitted only on its own schedule. The refused pole is Scorpio's depth — and it returns as the crisis or the passion that finally moves what patience had settled.
texts.mundane: Reliable with money, food, objects and time; slow to commit and slower to quit. The weak spot is inertia dressed as contentment — upheavals tend to arrive from outside because they were never scheduled from within.
texts.energy: Fixed earth: a dense, slow-charging current with enormous holding capacity. It resists surges — which keeps life stable, and makes real transformation feel like threat before it feels like renewal.
texts.minimal: Steady, embodied, keeps what it has. Scorpio across the axis brings the depths.

slots.ask: What would have to happen before you willingly let something go?

slots.label: Gemini (pole of the Gemini–Sagittarius axis)
slots.kernel: Gemini is the gathering pole of the Gemini–Sagittarius axis: curious, versatile, alive in words and quick connections. Its complement is Sagittarius — the single meaning it keeps deferring.

texts.jungian: Gemini lives the archetype of the messenger: everything is interesting, nothing is final, and the self stays light by staying plural. The deferred pole is Sagittarian conviction — committing to one meaning — and it returns as restlessness whenever cleverness starts tasting thin.
texts.mundane: Good at questions, introductions, errands and first drafts; allergic to the long haul of one big answer. Careers thrive on variety, and the corrective usually arrives as a nagging sense that all these threads ought to add up to something.
texts.energy: Mutable air: a branching signal current — many channels, low load on each. It refreshes fast and scatters fast; direction has to be chosen from the far pole, because it will not emerge from more input.
texts.minimal: Curious, versatile, spoken aloud. Sagittarius opposite holds the question of meaning.

slots.ask: Which of your many threads would hurt most to drop?

slots.label: Cancer (pole of the Cancer–Capricorn axis)
slots.kernel: Cancer is the rooting pole of the Cancer–Capricorn axis: protective, tidal, oriented to home, memory and belonging. Its complement is Capricorn — the public structure it shelters from.

texts.jungian: Cancer carries the mother-world: feeling as first knowledge, the past as living tissue, care as identity. Its unlived pole is Capricorn's impersonal demand — and it surfaces as the discovery that protecting someone is not the same as preparing them.
texts.mundane: Makes a home wherever it lands — of houses, teams, kitchens; remembers birthdays and slights with equal fidelity. When hurt it withdraws rather than negotiates, which others read as moodiness rather than the self-protection it is.
texts.energy: Cardinal water: a tidal current, advancing and withdrawing on feeling's schedule. Containment is its gift; the Capricorn pole adds the walls that keep their shape when the tide is out.
texts.minimal: Protective, tidal, rooted in the remembered. Capricorn opposite builds the outer wall.

slots.ask: Who is allowed inside the shell — and what did it take them?

slots.label: Leo (pole of the Leo–Aquarius axis)
slots.kernel: Leo is the radiant pole of the Leo–Aquarius axis: expressive, proud, ruled by the heart's need to be seen truly. Its complement is Aquarius — the cool wide view that relativises any king.

texts.jungian: Leo lives the archetype of the sovereign child: to exist is to shine, and love must be personal or it does not count. The refused pole is Aquarian detachment — being one among many — which returns as the audience's independence: they applaud, then go home to their own lives.
texts.mundane: Generous, warm, at its best given a stage and a cause it can champion in person. Criticism lands as dethronement; the corrective is the committee, the peer group — anywhere applause is replaced by parity.
texts.energy: Fixed fire: a steady radiant core, warmth broadcast from a centre that must not be doubted. It powers rooms and projects alike; the Aquarian pole routes that heat outward into the shared grid before it curdles into display.
texts.minimal: Expressive, proud, heart-led. Aquarius opposite asks it to be one of many.

slots.ask: What changes in you when nobody in the room is watching?

slots.label: Virgo (pole of the Virgo–Pisces axis)
slots.kernel: Virgo is the refining pole of the Virgo–Pisces axis: precise, useful, devoted to making things work and then work better. Its complement is Pisces — the unsorted whole its standards keep at bay.

texts.jungian: Virgo serves the archetype of the craftsman-priest: purity through work, worth through usefulness, anxiety managed by improvement. The banished pole is Piscean surrender — letting things be imperfect and whole — which returns as exhaustion before a task that was never finishable.
texts.mundane: The one who reads the instructions, fixes the process and notices the error nobody else saw; also prone to doing the whole team's worrying. Relief tends to arrive from the far pole — enforced rest, a mess that turned out fine, help accepted late.
texts.energy: Mutable earth: a fine discriminating current that sorts as it flows. Precision is its power and its drain; the Pisces pole restores by un-sorting — sleep, water, music, mercy.
texts.minimal: Precise, useful, self-critical. Pisces opposite forgives the unfinished.

slots.ask: What are you still improving that might already be good enough?

slots.label: Libra (pole of the Libra–Aries axis)
slots.kernel: Libra is the relating pole of the Aries–Libra axis: it thinks in twos, weighing itself against a partner, an opponent, a standard. Charming and unwilling to be crude, it can mistake being agreeable for being fair. Its complement is Aries — the blunt 'I want' it keeps polishing away.

texts.jungian: Libra lives the archetype of the diplomat, but under the good manners is a set of scales that never quite rests. Truth has to be beautiful here — its grace and its evasion — and the disowned Aries pole waits as the flash of temper that finally says the unsayable after years of being reasonable.
texts.mundane: At its best in negotiation, design and any room that has overheated; quietly manipulative at its worst, arranging outcomes while appearing to defer. The growth edge is blunt: state a preference before consulting everyone else's, and let someone be displeased.
texts.energy: Cardinal air held in balance — a current forever tilting the scales toward level, alive between two charges rather than at rest. It stalls when both pans are full; the Aries spark is what breaks the tie and lets it finally move.
texts.minimal: Weighs everything, itself included. Gracious, quietly steely. Aries opposite owns the naked want.

slots.ask: What do you actually want, before anyone else has voted?

slots.label: Scorpio (pole of the Scorpio–Taurus axis)
slots.kernel: Scorpio is the transforming pole of the Taurus–Scorpio axis: intense, guarded, committed to what is real beneath the surface. Its complement is Taurus — the calm possession it cannot quite trust.

texts.jungian: Scorpio lives the archetype of the initiate: nothing casual, nothing forgotten, love and power studied in the dark. Its refused pole is Taurean simplicity — resting in what one has — which returns as the suspicion that peace must be hiding something.
texts.mundane: Loyal to a few, formidable in crisis, suited to research, therapy, emergencies and audits. Ordinary sunlit sharing is the harder discipline — not every dinner needs an undertow.
texts.energy: Fixed water: a compressed current under high pressure, discharging in depth rather than breadth. It regenerates through crisis; the Taurus pole teaches slow charging — stability as a form of power rather than its absence.
texts.minimal: Intense, guarded, all-or-nothing. Taurus opposite rests in the tangible.

slots.ask: What might it feel like to enjoy something without testing it?

slots.label: Sagittarius (pole of the Sagittarius–Gemini axis)
slots.kernel: Sagittarius is the far-seeking pole of the Gemini–Sagittarius axis: it aims past the immediate at meaning, and trusts the arrow more than the map. Frank to the point of tactless, it would rather be free than be right in detail. Its complement is Gemini — the near fact that keeps the grand arc honest.

texts.jungian: Sagittarius lives the archetype of the pilgrim, forever certain the meaning is over the next hill and mildly allergic to the room it is in. Its neglected Gemini pole returns as the small awkward fact the great theory skipped — and as the people who wanted presence, not a lecture.
texts.mundane: Teaches, travels, sells the vision and bets big, often promising before the diary has been checked. The corrective is unglamorous: the detail pass — dates, names, small print — done before the leap, not in the wreckage after it.
texts.energy: Mutable fire on a long arc, loosed at the horizon and impatient of anything that drags. Momentum is both its medicine and its blind spot; the Gemini pole is the mid-flight correction that keeps it from overshooting entirely.
texts.minimal: Aims at meaning, blunt about it, restless in rooms. Gemini opposite keeps the facts in view.

slots.ask: Which inconvenient detail is your current big picture leaving out?

prevTexts.jungian: Sagittarius carries the archetype of the pilgrim: life must mean something, and the meaning is always over the next hill. Its neglected pole is Gemini's patient particulars — and they return as the awkward facts the great theory forgot to include.

prevTexts.minimal: Far-ranging, blunt, meaning-hungry. Gemini opposite keeps the facts in view.

slots.label: Capricorn (pole of the Capricorn–Cancer axis)
slots.kernel: Capricorn is the building pole of the Cancer–Capricorn axis: ambitious, enduring, ordered by responsibility and the long climb. Its complement is Cancer — the softness it postpones.

texts.jungian: Capricorn lives the archetype of the elder: worth is earned, feeling is scheduled, and the summit is expected to justify the frost. Its exiled pole is Cancerian need — being held rather than useful — which returns at the top of the mountain, asking who all this was for.
texts.mundane: Delivers, endures, runs things; holidays and retirement are its known hazards. The corrective is unproductive belonging — time with people who neither report to it nor grade it.
texts.energy: Cardinal earth: a crystallising current, pressure applied over years until structure forms. It bears loads others refuse; the Cancer pole keeps the stone warm, routing feeling in before the structure sets empty.
texts.minimal: Ambitious, enduring, duty-bound. Cancer opposite holds the reason why.

slots.ask: If nothing needed managing tonight, what would you do with the evening?

slots.label: Aquarius (pole of the Aquarius–Leo axis)
slots.kernel: Aquarius is the collective pole of the Leo–Aquarius axis: independent, systemic, loyal to principles and the wide pattern. Its complement is Leo — the personal heart it keeps at arm's length.

texts.jungian: Aquarius carries the archetype of the future's citizen: seeing the pattern, standing a little outside the very groups it serves. Its disowned pole is Leo's personal fire — wanting to matter as oneself — which returns as the outsider's quiet ache to be, just once, the exception.
texts.mundane: Strong with systems, causes, networks and reform; vaguer with birthdays, bedsides and 'how are you, really'. The corrective is showing up in person — one heart at a time rather than a mailing list.
texts.energy: Fixed air: a distributed current, stable across the whole grid, cool at any single node. It connects without merging; the Leo pole reminds the network that every node is somebody's sun.
texts.minimal: Independent, systemic, future-facing. Leo opposite insists the personal counts.

slots.ask: Which one person gets the warmth you usually give the cause?

slots.label: Pisces (pole of the Pisces–Virgo axis)
slots.kernel: Pisces is the dissolving pole of the Virgo–Pisces axis: porous, compassionate, at home in what cannot be measured. Its complement is Virgo — the edge and order it keeps forgetting.

texts.jungian: Pisces lives the archetype of the mystic: boundaries are provisional, suffering is shared tissue, and the self is happiest slightly dissolved. Its missing pole is Virgo's discrimination — this not that, mine not yours — which returns as the hard lesson that mercy without limits drowns the merciful.
texts.mundane: Kind to strangers, permeable to moods, gifted in art and care and anywhere the rulebook fails; paperwork, deadlines and saying no all need scaffolding. One working routine kept sacred is the raft this ocean asks for.
texts.energy: Mutable water: an oceanic current — no fixed banks, everything eventually connected. It restores others by absorption and pays for it in blur; the Virgo pole filters, giving form as a kindness to the formless.
texts.minimal: Porous, compassionate, edges optional. Virgo opposite lends the working routine.

slots.ask: Where does your compassion need a boundary to survive?
